conventions.axes: Y-up, right-handed; camera looks down -Z by default; ground is the XZ plane at y = 0
conventions.lightIntensity: three.js physical units (directional/hemisphere/ambient: lux-like; spot/point: candela, decay 2)
conventions.easing: named functions from kit/time.js `ease` (formulas in references/kit-api.md)
conventions.camera: fov is vertical field of view in degrees (three.js convention); sensor-agnostic

style.name: Ink Wash
style.description: Brush-and-ink painting coming to life on a large sheet of soft fibrous off-white paper with deckled edges, lying on a felt mat beside an ink stone, a water bowl and a brush rest. A real 3D brush tilts and presses along each planned stroke: ink appears exactly as far as the brush has travelled, width follows pressure, the stroke starts wet-dark and runs dry into streaky flying white, then the edges feather outward and the tone lightens as it dries. Broad grey washes bloom and settle with darker edges, a drop of indigo or vermilion spreads into a wet wash as a soft flower, and an abstract seal is pressed at the end.
motion: A stroke is a path with a pressure profile: the brush tip travels it and ink exists exactly as far as the brush has gone; width follows pressure.
Each stroke starts with a pooled dark where the brush lands and runs dry into streaky flying white as its planned ink load empties.
After the brush passes, wet ink bleeds (edges feather along the paper fibres) and lightens as it dries — a closed form of the stroke's own time.
Washes sweep in as broad wet shapes, bloom outward and settle with darker edges; a drop of colour into a wet wash opens as a soft flower.
Camera: high three-quarter view down onto the sheet, slow push-ins on what is being painted, long holds, end on the whole sheet.

objects.procedural: 3.0 x 1.7 m sheet of fibrous off-white paper with deckled edges on a charcoal felt mat; an ink layer re-rendered every frame from the ink-wash plan (washes, strokes with pressure/ink load/bleed/drying, wet-in-wet blooms, a seal) and absorbed by the paper shader; ink stone, ink stick, celadon water bowl with ripples, two colour dishes, porcelain brush rest, a bamboo brush posed from the plan, a soapstone seal block

notes.mechanism: Ink = half-float texture re-rendered every frame from planInk(PROGRAM) and t (stroke ribbons, wash SDF quads, blots, seal) and absorbed by the paper shader; brush/seal/ripples posed from the same plan; SCORE = scoreFromEvents(PLAN.events, inkVoices()) + beatTones per BEATS entry.
